$comment: Input to scripts/check_release_health.py. One entry per RELEASE LANE:
a tag namespace plus the workflow that is supposed to publish it.
The native lane is the one that failed four times in silence:
desktop-v0.1.0 (ModuleNotFoundError: tomllib on a pre-3.11 runner, run
29514474536). Each left an immutable public tag promising installers that
were never published, and native-release.yml has no failure notifier at
all -- nor could one see `cancelled` or `skipped`.
tag_without_release_grace_hours is 6 on the native lane because a full
macOS/Windows/Linux Tauri build, smoke test, and attest legitimately takes
far longer than a wheel; a run still waiting on the native-release human
approval gate suppresses the detector regardless of age.

lanes.name: PyPI package
lanes.remediation: gh workflow run release.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-desktop --ref main -f operation=semantic-release

lanes.name: Native installers
lanes.remediation:
# Rebuild the installers for an existing engine version (X.Y.Z), then
# approve the native-release environment when the publish-draft job requests it.
gh workflow run native-freshness.yml --repo OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-desktop --ref main -f version=X.Y.Z
